name: echoo
description: Echoo - a full-stack social platform. React 19 + TypeScript client, Express 5 + MongoDB API.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @echoo/api" "npm run dev -w @echoo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @echoo/api && npm run build -w @echoo/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @echoo/api && npm run lint -w @echoo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @echoo/api && npm run typecheck -w @echoo/web
